text.body:
Title: Narakoddharastava
Author: Nāgārjuna
Source: Lindtner 1979 collated with Tokyo University Library 205 [\A]; also cf. CUL MS Or.716.2
Tibetan: D 1137
Input: Péter-Dániel Szántó, 18/07/2025
[\ms1v] oṃ namo lokanāthāya ||
% p. 148
dāridrapaṅkasaṃmagnaṃ saṃsārasya mahodadhau |
% dāridrapaṅkalagnasya \A
parijñānaṃ samutpādya trāhi māṃ he tathāgata || 1
% pratijñānaṃ \A
timirāgārapraviṣṭaṃ anāthaduḥkhavedanam |
% timirāgārapraviṣṭo 'haṃ \A
% anāthaduḥkhavedanā \A
bandhuvargaiḥ parityaktaṃ trāhi māṃ he tathāgata || 2
% bandhuvargeṇa tyajito 'haṃ \A
mātā pitā bhaginy api putradārāsuhṛjjanāḥ |
% mātāpitṛbhagnīś caiva \A
% putradārasuhṛjjanāḥ \A
indrajālā mayā dṛṣṭās trāhi māṃ he tathāgata || 3
% indrajālamayā dṛṣṭaṃ \A
% p. 150
yan mayā parijanārthaṃ sukṛtaṃ karma duṣkṛtam |
% parijanasyārthe \A
ekākī tena yāsyāmi trāhi māṃ he tathāgata || 4
% pacyāmi \A
jīrṇakūpe mahāghore 'navagāhanasāgare |
% 'navagāhe sāgareṣu ca \A
andhabhūto 'smy ahaṃ nātha trāhi māṃ he tathāgata || 5
% vayaṃ \A
jīrṇā naukā samārūḍhā mahāsāgaralaṅghane |
% jīrṇanaukāsamārūḍho \A
durlaṅghyaṃ ca mayā dṛṣṭaṃ trāhi māṃ he tathāgata || 6
dharmādharmaṃ na vijñātaṃ gamyāgamyaṃ na veditam |
% dharmādharma \A
% gamyāgamya \A
acetanam idaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ trāhi māṃ he tathāgata || 7
% hi \A
% p. 152
mātṛghātaṃ pitṛghātaṃ pañcānantaryaṃ me kṛtam |
% mātṛghā[\A2r]taṃ
pacyāmi timiraṃ ghoraṃ trāhi māṃ he tathāgata || 8
kṛto mayā stūpabhedaḥ sāṃghikārtho vināśitaḥ |
% kṛtaṃ ... °bhedaṃ \A
% sāṃghikātha vināśitaḥ \A
kṛtā mayā sattvahiṃsā trāhi māṃ he tathāgata || 9
iha loke sukhaṃ nāsti paraloke na veditam |
% anne ihaloke
% sukhenāpi \A
% paralokaṃ na jānitam \A
veṣṭitaṃ karmasūtreṇa trāhi māṃ he tathāgata || 10
kāśipuṣpaṃ yathākāśe bhramate vāyunāhatam |
% kāśīpuṣpaṃ \A
īdṛśyaṃ jīvitaṃ hy idaṃ (!?) trāhi māṃ he tathāgata || 11
% īdṛśaṃ \A
% tasya \A
% ha \A
aṭavī kaṇṭakācchannā bahuvṛkṣanirāśrayam |
% kaṇṭakaś caiva \A
panthānaṃ nātra paśyāmi trāhi māṃ he tathāgata || 12
% panthā tatra na \A
% p. 154
anaparādhaṃ paśuś ca hatāḥ kāṇḍair mṛgā mayā |
% anaparādhe vasuś \A
% hatā kāṇṭair bahavo mṛgāḥ \A
rājāhaṃ mā tadāmanye (!) trāhi māṃ he tathāgata || 13
% rājāhaṃ ta<|thā|>dā manye \A
narake pacyamānasya kaścit trātā bhaviṣyati |
% pacyamānas tu \A
% kaści trāṇaṃ na vidyate \A
gacchāmi kasya śaraṇaṃ ko me trātā bhaviṣyati || 14
vaidyānāṃ vaidyarājāṃs tvaṃ (!) sarvavyādhicikitsakaḥ |
% vaidyarājas tu \A
% sarvavyādhici[\A2\verso] + + + +
lokanātha bhava trātā trailokye sacarācare || 15
% lokanātho bhave \A
\A adds:
narakoddharaṇastava samāptaḥ || ||
ye dharmā etc.
deyadharmo yaṃ pravaramahāyānayāyinyāḥ paramopāsikāmāṇḍalikaśrīśrīramālavadhūsūhavanāmadheyāyā
yad atra etc.
